kind: gen_input (a cation-disordered 2x2x2 Pca2_1 Hf16Zr16O64 cell carrying all nine oxygen environments + its per-site environment table + the fixed-lattice VASP relaxation deck)
provenance: 3_reproduction/L1/ (reproduced 2026-09-05, commit f970360): the ideal cells POSCAR_ideal_{hfo2,x050}.vasp, environments.csv (the 64-site classification, guards G3/G4), the as-run relaxB deck hpc_computations/pristine_x050_relaxB/{INCAR,KPOINTS}. The answer-set design follows reviewer's stage-4 note of 2026-09-04 (task_notes.md).
graded_object: the built cell (an answer SET: any decoration of the parent supercell with 16 Zr on the cation sublattice in which all nine environments occur; ours is one member), the agent's own site table checked for consistency against the 2.3 A classification of the submitted cell, and the relaxation deck's REQUIRED settings

topology_match.note: Zr is relabelled Hf before matching the ideal undoped 2x2x2 parent, so any valid Hf/Zr decoration remains allowed. Periodic global translations and atom reordering are allowed through a species-aware bijection; no inversion mapping. The 0.001 A tolerance covers coordinate serialization: translated/reordered POSCARs printed to six decimals differ by at most 1.21e-5 A in the verified fixtures. A relaxed replacement is outside the given-coordinate contract. Existing lattice tolerances remain unchanged.

environment_rule.sublattices: four cations = O4 (32 sites), three = O3 (32 sites)
environment_rule.note: our counts are one member of the answer set and are NOT graded; only presence of all nine classes and the 32 + 32 split are

site_table.rule: each row matched to one distinct oxygen of the submitted POSCAR by periodic distance; (n_Hf, n_Zr) must equal the classifier's on that structure (integers; an integral float such as 3.0 is accepted, a non-integral value fails)
site_table.tolerance_note: 0.25 A is safe because the shortest O-O separation in the ideal cell is 2.511 A, so any row within 0.25 A of an oxygen names it uniquely; a table printed with two decimals (worst error 0.063 A on the 10 A axes) is accepted

declared_pins.note: the relaxation converges to residual forces below 1e-4 eV/A (the paper's own criterion, SM computational methods); graded as |EDIFFG| <= 1e-4 with EDIFFG < 0. The lattice (fixed, through the staged parent cell), the 2x2x2 replication and x = 0.50 are given data, not pins.

encut_catalog: graderlib/grader_potcar_vasp54.yaml (Hf_pv 220.334, Zr_sv 229.898, O 400.000 eV); ENCUT floor = 1.0 * max ENMAX = 400 eV, REQUIRED-explicit

kmesh_reference.note: As-run reproduction mesh provenance. Grading uses the separate frozen kmesh_policy; centering and vacuum requirements remain independent.

incar_required.note: Each rule is on the EFFECTIVE value (explicit if set, else the VASP default). Only these settings are graded; the per-tag triage is in notes.md.
incar_required.relax_fixed_cell: ISIF effectively in {0, 1, 2} (ions only, cell fixed; default 2 passes; 3 fails), IBRION in {1, 2, 3} (explicit), EDIFFG < 0 with |EDIFFG| <= 1e-4 (explicit)
incar_required.functional: PBE: GGA absent or GGA = Pe
incar_required.kmesh: Frozen automatic-default minima from kmesh_policy, with the separately specified centering, vacuum and method constraints.

score: 1 only if the structure checks, the site-table checks and every deck rule pass (binary all-primary-pass)

kmesh_policy.source: Trusted reference input cell per run label; geometry-based density shared by VASP, QE and ABACUS. No inference from submitted settings.
kmesh_policy.rule: Each periodic-axis subdivision >= automatic default, without subtraction or relative margin. Vacuum axes are exactly 1. Berry strings retain their independent longitudinal condition.
